## Houston 1.0.21

### What's new

- Large attachments and imports now upload in pieces, with progress, and pick up where they left off after a dropped connection. You can attach files up to 100 MB.
- New OpenAI models: GPT-6.2 Sol and GPT-6.2 Astra, available with your ChatGPT subscription.
- Typing in the chat box is smoother, with no delay between keystrokes.
- Fixes for opening one PDF right after another, Houston links on Linux, and MiniMax and local models.

### Before you upgrade

- Quit Houston before installing. macOS doesn't always replace a running app. If in doubt, delete Houston from Applications and drag the new copy in.
